title: Pack a gym bag and keep used shoes away from clean accessories
instruction: Pack the teal capped water bottle on the coffee-table tray, both blue-and-white running shoes on the floor, the black wallet on the sofa, and the over-ear headphones on the sofa into the open olive-green gym bag. Put the shoes together at one end of the bag and keep the wallet and headphones at the opposite end, leaving at least 12 cm between the two groups along the length of the bag. Leave all five objects fully inside the bag, let go of them, and move both grippers clear.
context: Prepare one bag for a gym and grocery outing. Keeping the used running shoes at the opposite end from the wallet and headphones keeps dirt away from items handled during the shopping trip.
setup: Fixed furnished living room with two 6-DoF YAM arms on floor stands. From above, the olive canvas-and-leather duffel (67.2 × 46.2 × 29.5 cm body) is open on a footstool between the stands. A teal capped steel bottle (7.3 cm diameter × 25.6 cm long, 250 g) lies in a 29 × 16 cm silicone tray on the stone-and-wood coffee table. Two blue-white fabric-and-rubber running shoes (each 29.7 × 11.0 × 10.5 cm, 300 g) are side by side on the wool rug. A closed leather wallet (11.5 × 9.0 × 1.5 cm, 120 g) and plastic/metal/padded over-ear headphones (20.2 × 8.35 × 17.75 cm, 250 g) rest separately on the linen sofa. An upright spare bottle and canvas tote stay in the background. Exact poses, materials and measured scene inventory are in the task files.
scoring: Each qualifying object scores independently: bottle 0.20, each shoe 0.10, wallet 0.20, headphones 0.20. Each object must satisfy the following for the final 40 controls. Every mesh vertex lies inside the bag-local volume X ±30 cm, Y ±18.645 cm, Z 4.35–24.5 cm above the bag origin. Linear speed is below 1 cm/s, angular speed is below 0.1 rad/s, measured gripper normal force is below 0.02 N total, and both gripper tool centers are more than 16 cm from its bounding-box center. Both shoes, wallet and headphones must qualify, with at least 12 cm of edge-to-edge clearance between the shoe group and the wallet/headphone group along the bag long axis over the same 40 controls, for the remaining 0.20. Either bag end is valid for the shoes. Any support within the bag is allowed. A run may terminate early once the score reaches 1.0.
reset_notes: Reset to the documented seed-0 layout with zero object jitter and both YAM arms in their READY pose. The bag is already open, with handles folded out of the way before reset.
fidelity: Real-scale rigid target objects and static colliding furniture. The duffel keeps the source appearance with a widened open body, rigid lining and floor, fixed position and outward-folded handles. Fabric flex, zipper operation, moving clasps and bottle liquid are omitted. Background objects are static.
